business_summary: Cedar Ridge HVAC & Controls is managing summer HVAC sales and installation work with explicit source-of-truth rules. Current sales stage and next action belong in HearthCRM, while project task and milestone status belong in JobBoardPM. Slack and email provide evidence about Fulton Dental and Riverbend Brewery work, but operational statuses from those messages need confirmation in the stated systems of record. Future system changes are planned for BuildBoard crew scheduling on 2026-07-15 and PipelinePro sales stages and next actions on 2026-08-01.
